content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi, also known as IIT BHU. It is a prestigious government institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow. This position is typically research-oriented.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment drive. Candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Junior Research Fellow post is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow post is via Email. Applicants need to send their documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 35 years. Age relaxations will be applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a BE/BTech (min 75%) or ME/MTech/MSc/MCA (min 60%) in Computer Science or related discipline with a valid GATE/NET score.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow post. Applications are free.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post includes an Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be assessed on their qualifications and performance.
